scope: NCAAF only; original Shadow and original Shadow V2 forecast unchanged

candidates.name: gamma_poisson_fixed_k20
candidates.parameter: shared Gamma shape k=20, not calibrated

selection: No selection based on the already-exposed Oct 5-11 cohort; parameters frozen prospectively only after independent review of protocol
eligibility: All completed FBS regular-season games with full strictly-prior source features; exclusions and reasons frozen before kickoff

evaluation.primary_metric: joint exact-score mean negative log likelihood
evaluation.comparison: Paired game-by-game differences to both frozen Poisson references, with uncertainty intervals; no opportunistic subgroup selection
evaluation.release_gate: Independent review of methodology, source integrity, parameter freeze and prospective results; explicit user-authorized promotion after evidence, never automatic
